title: Die Urkunden und Akten des Klosters und des Oberamts Königsfelden – 1308-1662
institution: Historisches Seminar, Universität Zürich (Simon Teuscher, Colette Halter-Pernet, Tobias Hodel); owner Staatsarchiv Aargau
license_note: Editions data are CC BY 4.0; the platform is CC BY-NC-SA; the images are in the public domain.
notes: Charters and records of the Königsfelden convent and the later Bernese Hofmeisterei: about 1,000 single documents and three copy books, transcribed and tagged for persons, places and organisations, with a standardised and a diplomatic view. The Zenodo data dump (version of 9 April 2024, 1,557 TEI document files) lists 459 documents dated within or overlapping 1450-1700, in Early New High German (428) and Latin (18 marked; the rest unmarked). Moved to the Sources Online server (TEI Publisher) in early 2024. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
